definitions.explanation: The smallest unit of matter that retains the properties of an element. A fundamental concept in chemistry and physics.

examples.english: Atoms are invisible to the eye.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水素|すいそ}→水素：00387_suiso⟧{原子|げんし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧{原子|げんし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Water is made of hydrogen atoms and oxygen atoms.

examples.japanese: {原子|げんし}{爆弾|ばくだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{原子|げんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分裂|ぶんれつ}→分裂：11747_bunretsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Atomic bombs use the splitting of atoms.

notes:
{原子|げんし} is the smallest unit of a chemical element. Composed of {原|げん} (origin/fundamental) + {子|し} (small unit/particle).

COMPOUNDS:
- {原子|げんし}{爆弾|ばくだん} (⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧): atomic bomb
- {原子|げんし}{力|りょく}: atomic/nuclear power
- {原子|げんし}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: atomic number
- {原子|げんし}{核|かく}: atomic nucleus
- {原子|げんし}{力|りょく}{発電所|はつでんしょ} (⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧): nuclear power plant

RELATED PARTICLES:
- ⟦{分子|ぶんし}→分子：11769_bunshi⟧: molecule (group of atoms)
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧: electron
- ⟦{陽子|ようし}→陽子：28122_youshi⟧: proton
- ⟦{中性子|ちゅうせいし}→中性子：28123_chuuseishi⟧: neutron

WATCH OUT:
⟦{原始|げんし}→原始：00067_genshi⟧ means "primitive" or "primeval" — a completely different word. See the cross-reference above.
